description: 한국환경공단_철도소음 측정정보 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국환경공단. 한국환경공단이 제공하는 ‘철도소음 측정정보’는 전국 철도 노선 주변에서 실시간으로 측정된 소음 수준을 체계적으로 정리한 데이터셋이다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국환경공단. Its tags are 철도소음, 측정정보, 환경, 환경기상. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
